text:
anna: Heads-up — after merging #3421 (upgrade-guide) CI previews exploded: linkcheck + vale + spellcheck all failing across multiple files. Not just one PR, seems like a cascade from the new vale rule update.

docs-ci-bot: Preview failed for PR 3421 (docs/upgrade-guide): linkcheck=5 broken, vale=18 matches (SentenceCase, TitlePunctuation), spellcheck=7 words flagged. Logs: https://ci.internal/preview/3421

mike: I can triage linkcheck. Any quick grep for anchors?

anna: Use this to find suspicious anchors: `git show origin/main:docs/upgrade.md | nl -ba | sed -n '1,300p'` — then compare against linkcheck output. Most broken ones are fragment links to headings that got converted from sentence case to title case by the vale rule.

sophia: For vale: the new rule set bumped SentenceCase -> error for a lot of example headings. We could either: 1) add `:vale disable=SentenceCase` frontmatter for the affected files temporarily, or 2) tweak .vale.ini to set SentenceCase to warning for the docs/* path while we sweep. Which do we prefer?

mike: I'm leaning to the .vale.ini toggle so we don't touch many files. Quick patch in a single commit.

chloe: FYI the SDK snippet in `examples/python/client_usage.md` also trips spellcheck because of a camelCase variable in a code block that our spellchecker scans. We should wrap that block with `<!-- spellcheck:disable -->` and `<!-- spellcheck:enable -->` so it doesn't flag real code.

dan: We need a merge window. My calendar's open at 02:00 UTC for a small maintenance slot. If we can land a single commit that: updates .vale.ini, adds spellcheck disables around code blocks, and fixes the 5 broken links (or adds redirect anchors), I can take care of the merge slot.

anna: Plan: mike => patch link fixes + spell-disable comments; sophia => .vale.ini PR that sets SentenceCase=warning for docs/ and adds short note in CHANGES.md; chloe => confirm SDK snippet fix. Target: push patch by 01:30 UTC so dan can merge at 02:00 UTC.

mike: Working on link fixes now. Quick local check command: `npm run docs:preview -- --local-check` then `grep -E "broken link|Anchor not found" docs/.logs/preview-3421.log`

sophia: I'll open the .vale.ini PR and reference this thread. Will add `# temp: relax sentencecase for bulk migration` and set a 7-day TTL comment.

chloe: SDK snippet updated and comments added. Pushed in branch `docs/3421-snippet-fix`.

docs-ci-bot: New preview builds created: PR 3421 linkfix branch (preview/3421-linkfix) and PR 3421 vale-tmp branch (preview/3421-vale-relax). Running checks...

anna: If previews pass, ping @dan for merge. If vale still errors, we'll fallback to per-file `:vale disable` for the worst offenders.

mike: Linkfix preview shows 0 broken links locally; pushing now. ETA push in ~3m.

sophia: Vale-relax PR is up. I set SentenceCase=warning and added the CHANGES note.

dan: I'll watch the previews and take the 02:00 slot. Ping me when both previews show green.

docs-ci-bot: preview/3421-linkfix passed: linkcheck=0, spellcheck=1 (code-block flagged). preview/3421-vale-relax passed: vale warnings only.

anna: Great — dan, green to merge when ready. Thanks everyone.

chloe: re: the one remaining spell flag, I added `<!-- spellcheck:disable -->` around that code block in the PR; preview re-run shows clear.

dan: Merged both PRs in the 02:00 UTC slot. Post-merge: monitoring for any downstream preview fallout.

anna: Post-mortem action items: 1) Add a short runbook for 'vale rule bump' that includes using .vale.ini relax and TTL comment. 2) Add spellcheck-ignore for code fences in our docs linter config. 3) Add a small script to map changed headings -> anchors to preempt link drift on big title-case changes. I'll draft ASAP. :memo:
